evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Document properties and metadata are maintained automatically or by the user.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A workflow-supported approval process releases a document.

evts.name: distribute_document
evts.description: Distribution lists are used to inform assigned user groups or persons about released documents.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Invalid documents are archived by withdrawing authorizations except for the archive group.

o2o.description: Documents are classified by selected document types.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.

o2e.description: The event creates a managed document.
New documents are created by attaching a new information object.
A corresponding document type is selected when creating a document.
The event maintains document properties and metadata.
Release processing is workflow-supported through tasks.
Distribution concerns the corresponding released document.
Distribution is maintained through distribution lists.
